info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Investment Portfolio Update API
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Update API allows users to modify existing investment portfolios through targeted updates. Financial advisors and portfolio managers can utilize this endpoint to adjust asset allocations, update investment strategies, or modify client preferences. This API streamlines the management of client investments, ensuring accurate and efficient portfolio administration. Typical use cases include updating risk profiles or reallocating assets based on market conditions, enhancing the overall investment experience for clients.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific investment portfolio identified by RES-100045. Provide the necessary fields in the request body to modify the portfolio's attributes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update specific details of an investment portfolio management operation identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the provided data conforms to the schema requirements for successful processing.
